subject: Commit path recertify + PO batch instructions
messages:
From: Alex Carson <alex.carson@quellhealth.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@quellhealth.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: vendor recertification & capacity uplift

Hi Rachel,

Hope you’re well — QuellHealth is kicking off our renewal/expansion work for the RDW-2026-1457 commitment. Procurement needs the vendor recertification packet (SOC2, data handling attestation) and a short runbook for PO batching so we can present to finance by 9/22. We’re aiming to add a Tier-2 capacity uplift (+2 dedicated nodes) and extend the term by 12 months, but we need to confirm the commit ladder and the PO format your billing team expects.

Can you send:
- A single evidence bundle or link to the SOC2 + encryption attestations
- The SOW draft that reflects the Tier-2 uplift and adjusted pricing ladder
- Instructions for submitting a batched PO (PO number format, any locking/capture language)

I’ve attached Procurement Questionnaire v1 for any fields your side wants to prefill. If possible, we’d like to have the paperwork ready to route through our internal portal by 9/20.

Thanks — I’ll loop in procurement contacts if you need anything else.

—Alex
Alex Carson
Procurement Manager, QuellHealth
alex.carson@quellhealth.com
Attachment: procurement-questionnaire-QuellHealth.pdf (1 page)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Carson <alex.carson@quellhealth.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: vendor recertification & capacity uplift

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. Below is the pack we’ll provide and the short PO-batch instructions so your finance team can align. I’ve cc’d Jonas and Neha for pricing and security items.

What we’re attaching/sendable:
- Evidence bundle (single ZIP): Redwood_SOC2_Type2_summary.pdf, KMS-attestation.pdf, data-retention-policy.pdf — will send consolidated ZIP by EOD 9/15.
- SOW_draft_v2.docx — includes Tier-2 uplift (+2 nodes), usage tiers, and the 12-month term extension language. Please review the capacity table (section 2.1) and confirm the target tokens/day/throughput.
- Pricing ladder (separate sheet) — standard commit ladder with step-ups at 3/6/12 months; Jonas will attach the XLS with incremental unit price lines.

PO batching and submission guidance (for QuellHealth finance portal):
- PO format: PO numbers should use this prefix: QH-RDW-YYMM-#### (e.g., QH-RDW-2609-0042).
- Invoice capture: For batched POs, include a single master PO referencing the SOW and a list of sub-invoices by month. Our billing system accepts a single PDF per PO.
- DocuSign: We can provide a single envelope if you want one signature path for legal + finance.

Action items for you: confirm the exact capacity numbers (tokens/day or nodes), and whether finance will submit a master PO or month-by-month invoices. If you want us to prefill procurement questionnaire fields, attach that back and we’ll return a completed PDF.

Attachments: SOW_draft_v2.docx; evidence-inventory.csv (inventory of files we will include in the ZIP).

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Sr. Customer Success Manager — Renewals, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.ai

On Tue, Sep 14, 2026 at 11:03 AM Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the clear ask. Below is the pack we’ll provide and the short PO-batch instructions so your finance team can align.

Adding the pricing ladder here. For the Tier-2 uplift we recommend the 12-month ladder with a staged discount:
- Month 0–2: baseline price (no discount) for new nodes
- Month 3–5: 7% commit discount once usage crosses 60% of committed tokens
- Month 6+: 12% discount at sustained commit

Attached: pricing-ladder-QuellHealth.xlsx (tabbed: "Commit Ladder", "Node Uplift"). If QuellHealth prefers a firm fixed price for nodes we can convert the ladder into a fixed monthly unit rate — note that fixed pricing requires longer-term commit (24 months) for parity.

Kimberly — can you confirm billing code and whether we should request the master PO with line items (preferred) or accept a blanket PO + monthly sub-invoices?

-Jonas
Director, Commercial Operations
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Attachment: pricing-ladder-QuellHealth.xlsx
